ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hand washing PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hand washing PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hand washing PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hand washing PRACTICES.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.

18. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

19. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
